grammar.label: the legal sentence — drafting so that it cannot be read two ways
grammar.form: defined terms, enumerated conditions, the ordered proviso
grammar.meaning: removes every reading but one, at the cost of readability

explanation.en: Legal drafting is the only English where ambiguity is a defect with a price attached, so it accepts ugliness in exchange for certainty: defined terms in capitals, conditions numbered rather than listed, 'and' and 'or' never left to context. A sentence that reads badly and cannot be misread has done its job.
explanation.uz: Huquqiy matn — noaniqlik narxi bor yagona ingliz tili sohasi. Shuning uchun u aniqlik evaziga xunuklikni qabul qiladi: shartlar raqamlangan, 'and' va 'or' hech qachon kontekstga qoldirilmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: The Tenant shall: (a) give notice in writing; and (b) do so before 1 March.
grammar.negative_example: The Tenant shall give notice in writing and do so before March, or as agreed.

l1_notes.uz: Huquqiy uslub o'zbek va rus tillarida ham bor, lekin shakli boshqacha; ingliz shartnomasidagi raqamlash tizimi alohida o'rganiladi.

grammar.label: plain English against the same problem
grammar.form: short sentences, active verbs, named actors, no defined terms
grammar.meaning: makes an obligation understandable to the person it binds

explanation.en: The plain-English movement exists because the legal sentence, perfected, is unreadable by the person it governs. Both are right and they cannot both be satisfied. What C2 can do is know which failure is worse in a given document: a tenant who cannot understand the lease, or a clause a court can read two ways.
explanation.uz: Sodda ingliz harakati huquqiy jumla mukammallashganda, uni boshqaradigan odam o'qiy olmaganidan kelib chiqqan. Ikkalasi ham haq va ikkalasini birga qondirib bo'lmaydi.

body.text: That is the whole point of it. It is ugly and it has exactly one meaning, and in an agreement one meaning is worth more than beauty.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'Do not change the flat without written permission from the landlord.' Shorter, clearer, and now three words are doing what eleven were doing before.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: For a tenant reading it on the first night, the second. For two lawyers arguing about it in four years, the first.
